name: 14寸锂电三模式轻便电动自行车款
description: 锂电轻便、电动助力人力三模骑行、加固车架四色可选的城市代步电动自行车

styleLock.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for infographic and variant screens, deep storm charcoal #2E3238 for the energy hero, deep teal #2FA893 for the closing screen
styleLock.lightingSystem: dramatic directional key on hero and scene shots, bright even high-key studio light on infographic shots, soft contact shadows, cool neutral tone
styleLock.surfaceSystem: asphalt road #3A3D40 for energy shots, clean studio floor with light grey band #EDEDEB for packshot screens
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; bold italic display treatment for energy headlines; short bold labels and callouts throughout
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons, single #2FA893 accent color, rounded rectangular info labels
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale and centered placement; hero energy angle reserved for opening and closing shots; strict 90-degree side profile for variant and silhouette screens
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent high-energy urban mobility ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, deep storm charcoal #2E3238, mid neutral grey #8A8D91 and one teal accent #2FA893; cool-toned lighting with dramatic directional key on hero shots and bright even studio light on infographic shots; modern geometric sans-serif with bold italic display headlines for energy shots; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line icons; clean commercial product photography mixed with minimal infographic bands; stable product scale and centered placement with clean even margins on all info screens; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 用低角度公路冲刺的一秒气势抓住点击，并带出三条核心卖点
shots.camera: very low angle front 3/4 view looking slightly upward, full product visible on an open road
shots.lighting: dramatic directional key from the upper right, cool moody tone, subtle motion blur on the road, soft contact shadow under the wheels
shots.background: dark storm sky gradient #2E3238 over asphalt road #3A3D40
shots.textZone: top center bold headline 「{selling_point_1}」 plus one subheadline 「{selling_point_2}」 in #FFFFFF; slim #2FA893 strip at the bottom carrying three short labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: Dramatic e-commerce energy hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle at a front 3/4 view looking slightly upward, full product visible on an open asphalt road. Dramatic directional key light from the upper right, cool moody tone, subtle motion blur on the road surface, soft contact shadow under the wheels. Dark storm sky gradient background #2E3238 over asphalt road #3A3D40. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with the top of the image kept as dark storm sky. A bold headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one subheadline 「{selling_point_2}」 in #FFFFFF sit top center over the sky, and a slim #2FA893 strip runs along the bottom edge carrying three short labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF. 8K commercial quality. Negative: no invented range, speed or slope numbers, no rider, no extra vehicles, no watermark, no fake logo, no garbled text, no cut-off wheels.

shots.lighting: bright even studio light, cool neutral tone, soft contact shadow under the wheels

shots.textZone: right panel copy block: short pain headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2E3238 with two short supporting lines 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」 and a small #2FA893 underline accent

provenance.notes: 从 8 张详情长图切片提炼。已剥离：包图网水印、凤凰/PHOENIX 品牌字、原文案（含续航/坡度数值）、会员二维码；所有规格数值改用 {callout} 文案槽由投放时填入，资质证明不合成、以图内可核验的保障信息与图形图标直接呈现。panel-01 主视觉车辆与参数页车辆形态不一致，模版统一按参数页的 14 寸锂电电动自行车为主产品；主视觉仅保留低角度公路冲刺的构图语法。
